expected.title: First order thickenings are exactly square-zero quasi-coherent ideal extensions of the structure sheaf
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises first order thickenings over a base algebraically: a short exact sequence 0 -> I -> A -> O_X -> 0 of sheaves on X with A a sheaf of f^{-1}O_S-algebras, I of square zero and I quasi-coherent as an O_X-module makes X' = (X, A) a scheme and X -> X' a first order thickening over S, and every first order thickening arises this way (statement lines 93-108). The substance is the local computation: on an affine open U = Spec(B) the vanishing of H^1(U, I) makes A = Gamma(U, A) -> B surjective, and the candidate isomorphism (U, A|_U) -> Spec(A) has to be checked on local rings, which is done by comparing two short exact sequences whose outer arrows are isomorphisms precisely because I and O_X are quasi-coherent (proof lines 112-150). The author leaves the converse direction implicit and it is reproduced as written. The claim is H2: a genuine local-ring computation with one vanishing input, not a citation.

expected.title: Two open immersions of finite type separated schemes over a common open can be made part of one separated finite type scheme by admissible blowups
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated S with open immersions U -> X_1 and U -> X_2 of schemes of finite type and separated over S, the lemma asserts the existence of a commutative diagram whose arrows X_i' -> X_i are U-admissible blowups, whose arrows X_i' -> X are open immersions, and whose X is separated and of finite type over S (statement lines 9646-9661). The proof works throughout with separated finite type schemes, so that the scheme theoretic image of an immersion is a closed subscheme containing the source as a dense open, and starts from X_12, the scheme theoretic image of U in X_1 x_S X_2, whose projections induce isomorphisms over U by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-of-partial-section (proof lines 9663-9680). It chooses U-admissible blowups X_i^i -> X_i making the strict transform X_12^i an open subscheme of X_i^i via Lemma labelled lemma-zariski-after-blowup with ideal I_i, observes that X_12^i -> X_12 is the blowup in p_i^{-1}I_i O_{X_12} by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-strict-transform, blows X_12 up in the product of the two pulled back ideals so that both transforms appear in one commutative square, and extends the resulting blowup to X_i^i using Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-extend-admissible-blowups (proof lines 9682-9708). The key point is that X'_12 -> X_1' x_S X_2' is an immersion which is proper, hence a closed immersion by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-image-proper-scheme-closed, so glueing X_1' and X_2' along the common open X'_12 produces a scheme X which is finite type and separated over S by Lemma labelled lemma-check-separated; compositions of U-admissible blowups are again U-admissible by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-composition-admissible-blowups (proof lines 9710-9725). Producing one blowup of X_12 dominating both strict transforms and then gluing along it is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.

expected.title: Scheme-theoretic density in a generic fibre spreads over an open subset of an irreducible base
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: A topologically dense open need not detect embedded or nilpotent structure, so a finite algebraic injectivity test must be built. The proof encodes the generic density by multiplication with finitely many functions, applies generic flatness to the algebra and cokernel, and transports the exact injection to every fibre on the chosen open.

expected.title: Normalization commutes with separable field extension and changes only by a universal homeomorphism under arbitrary field extension
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The proof compares total rings of fractions and their integral closures while allowing nilpotents after inseparable base change. Every integral element is descended to a finitely generated subfield and a suitable Frobenius power is transferred to its maximal separable subextension, proving the universal-homeomorphism assertion.

expected.title: A refined algebraization step: gluing coherent systems with proper support
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: 这条引理是 Grothendieck 存在定理证明里最重的一段：给定逐层系统 (F_n) 与额外对象 H，要造出整体凝聚模并同时控制其支集的 proper 性。关键操作有两处：一是用「核被 K 的幂零化」把核的支集压进 G_1 的支集；二是把核与 H 的支集相并，借助闭支集并集仍 proper 的引理得到结论。不能常规完成的是第一步——零化性必须从假设 (1) 的逐层等价与映射的构造中读出，而不是由定义直接给出。原文位于第 9827–9938 行。
